source_initialization: Farama DoorKeyEnv(size=8).reset(seed), DeepMind Apprehend random.seed(seed) before original make_game
original_public_observations: Farama public original uint8 (7,7,3), Pycolab original repainted public uint8 (10,7), hide P and b as X
common_raw_public_feature_encoder: Eight contiguous equal-width slices of full original public flattened bytes, per slice (mean byte /255, nonzero fraction), plus seven fixed action one-hot, exactly same observable derived features to all supervised competitors; full original public bytes never supplied to one model in preference to another.
target: Eight next-public frame slice binary changed/unchanged indicators comparing original public current vs next after genuine native source step, predicted before step.

model_controls.memoryless: 23-input 8-output conventional regularized sigmoid logistic, full-batch gradient trained for 100 epochs; no historical inputs
model_controls.explicit_history: 69-input 8-output regularized sigmoid logistic: common 23 current features plus two previous 23 input vectors, trained on same training seed episodes; zero both previous vectors for same-weights history ablation
model_controls.recurrent: Conventional tanh 8-state 23-input recurrent network trained by full episode analytic BPTT for 24 fixed epochs, 2 frozen initializations, choose by TRAINING score only; no heldout tuning
model_controls.recurrent_ablation: Same fully trained recurrent weights, hidden state zeroed every step at scoring; does not retrain
model_controls.bayesian: Public-encoded current 16 feature bins + announced action, 128-key bounded Beta-Bernoulli counts trained on all source training episodes, global action posterior fallback
model_controls.symbolic_history: Public-encoded current 16 feature bins + announced action and previous two 23-value feature bins, 128-key bounded finite-context rule frequency table with global fallback; trained on all source training episodes

historical_prospective_control_condition: Compare held-development per-reset seed Brier: full history logistic vs trained memoryless and its same-weight history zero-ablation; recurrent vs trained memoryless and same-weight zero-state; Bayesian and symbolic included as stronger/alternative conventional comparisons.
information_DEV_GO: Both native source families: history logistic strictly better than memoryless by >=0.002 absolute mean 8-bit held-development Brier; >=7 of 10 independent evaluation seed clusters improve, same-weight history ablation strictly worse; recurrent no worse than memoryless in either source. This only qualifies one development hypothesis, not scientific admission.
negative_falsifiers: History advantage absent or ablation ineffective => information benefit NOT demonstrated for tested encoding/training budget. Stop; no post-result parameter tuning, model selection on evaluation seeds, additional seed searches, or reinterpretation of retrospectives as prospective.
equal_access_limit: Every model sees same 16 derived current-public values + same announced action, but different architecture/memory sizes; do NOT claim equal total resource matched without budget matching.
evidence: Exact full original native source action/public digest with 30 genuine reset-seed episodes per engine; original upstream SHA unchanged and clean. Windows ×2 Ubuntu ×2 native exact predictive scores/source traces; full worker process CPU+peak RSS and per-model isolated training/inference CPU, checkpoint JSON byte counts, in-process recurrent state messages/read proxies. No source-private info to model.
